task_a: Allow Argument.argOptional() to clear stale default values when converting required arguments into optional arguments.
task_b: Allow Command.addArgument() to treat prepared required arguments with defaults as optional fallback arguments.
merge_result: Patch A and Patch B apply cleanly to the same base commit with git apply; no textual conflict is reported.
failure_summary: Patch A changes argOptional() so it clears default values. Patch B starts using argOptional() to reinterpret required arguments with defaults as optional fallback arguments. Together, the fallback value is silently discarded, so a missing argument resolves to undefined instead of the configured default.
notes: Commander.js API-contract interaction around default-bearing positional arguments and helper reuse.
